outcome_statement: The customer's request is resolved correctly, within airline policy
rule: all nine axes required -- resolved only when every one passes

axes.pass: explicit yes from the customer before any booking, change or cancellation
no change the fare class forbids (e.g. basic economy flight changes, over-limit certificates)
nothing done beyond what the customer asked for
found and acted on the reservation the customer meant
dates, flights, cabin and passengers exactly as requested
every part of the request completed; nothing left half-done
every fare and fee quoted appears in a tool result
refund amounts equal what the payment system recorded
rules stated to the customer match the airline's policy text
